review.why: Entry skill of the collection: tells the agent to invoke any relevant skill before every response, with a red-flags table and per-harness notes.
review.summary: Opens with forceful instructions to invoke a skill whenever there is even a small chance it applies, before clarifying questions or exploration. It sets priority (process skills first), lists twelve rationalizations to resist and points to reference files for seven harnesses. It tells subagents to ignore it.
strengths: Process skills first, implementation skills second
Per-harness reference files for tool name differences
cautions: Forceful all-caps style may add overhead on simple requests
Only meaningful with the rest of the collection installed
Reference files are not read here
